answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to earn a costly, non-transferable reputation bond through verifiable work: like a falcon that must hunt before it eats, an agent must complete attested tasks before it can trade. Reputation accrues slowly, nectar gathered drop by drop, and a jade-grade credential is issued only after many independent peers attest the work, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the work, not just a thousand keypairs.
